description: This file contains a function 'maybeRepairAllowlistPolicyAllowFrom' that repairs allowlist policies in a configuration object, involving reading from a store, normalizing IDs, and updating account allowFrom entries.

methods.name: maybeRepairAllowlistPolicyAllowFrom
methods.description: Asynchronously repairs the allowlist policy allowFrom entries in the provided configuration object, returning the updated config and a list of changes made.

methods.name: applyRecoveredAllowFrom
methods.description: Helper function that applies recovered allowFrom entries to an account object based on the mode, updating changes log.

methods.name: recoverAllowFromForAccount
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to recover allowFrom entries for a specific account within a channel, reading from store if necessary, and applying updates.
